execution.trigger: The loop in the refundAll() function starts executing for each address.
execution.state_issue: The state allows an attacker to exploit a single failed send operation, causing all subsequent sends to fail as well.
execution.exploitable_behavior: If any address does not have sufficient funds, it will throw an exception and prevent further processing of other addresses.

causality.state: The state allows sending transactions without checking if the address has sufficient balance.
causality.guard: No guard against insufficient balance in any address.
causality.transition: The loop continues even after a failed send, causing unintended DoS.
causality.capability: An attacker can exploit this by targeting an address with insufficient funds.
causality.outcome: Multiple sends fail if one address is insufficiently funded.
